commits.subject: Use platform line ending when opening single line files (#739)
commits.disposition: Strict CRLF-majority detection already exists. Files without newlines retain the configured default, whose initial value follows the platform.

commits.subject: Create parent directories when saving to a non-existent path (#738)
commits.disposition: Create missing parent directories through the validated atomic-save path; classify Windows missing-parent errors as not-found.

commits.subject: Add proper multithreading support to Arena (#741)
commits.disposition: Retain existing stronger TLS scratch ownership and release-mode nesting checks; add compatible 32-bit commit sizing and allocation-helper inlining. Do not replace checked fallible allocation with unchecked arithmetic.

commits.subject: Add a JSON parser (#742)
commits.disposition: Existing serde_json/jsonc-parser implementations provide settings and editable JSON support. A second custom arena JSON parser is not introduced; its fixture is included in highlighting validation.

commits.subject: Add a glob matcher (#743)
commits.disposition: Current vendored LSH already contains the upstream glob matcher; file associations now use it. No separate editor-local matcher is required.

commits.subject: Clean up error handling (#745)
commits.disposition: Adopt unstable file/encoding-list sorting and per-row render scratch lifetime. Preserve OGEdit error representation and conflict/recovery diagnostics; public API-only io::Error migration is not applied.

commits.subject: Fix the latest clippy warning (#751)
commits.disposition: Apply applicable ICU provider iteration/lint cleanup while retaining initialized caches and immutable native function tables.

commits.subject: Fix warnings when building on macOS (#754)
commits.disposition: Temporary Size constants are absent. Retained Unix CStr import is used by the fork error formatter, so upstream deletion would be incorrect; no runtime gap remains.

commits.subject: Remove the majority of nightly features (#761)
commits.disposition: Use VecDeque for history and document MRU traversal, removing linked-list cursor APIs. Keep the pinned nightly and checked arena-backed collections for remaining allocator features.

commits.subject: Change copyright in draw_menubar.rs (#760)
commits.disposition: Update About copyright wording while retaining OGEdit branding.

commits.subject: Remove allocator_api (#762)
commits.disposition: Retain hardened standard Vec/ArenaString allocator interface instead of replacing all collections with BVec/BString. Preserve generic MemsetSafe behavior and safe fallback fills. This does not claim stable-toolchain compatibility.

commits.subject: BVec::push_encode_utf16, Some micro optimizations (#764)
commits.disposition: Retain single-crate Unicode layout and standard collection conversion. Upstream moves Utf8Chars unchanged into stdext and optimizes BVec plus UTF-8-to-UTF-16 collection conversion; OGEdit regex construction uses pattern.encode_utf16(). Later decoding fixes are tracked separately.

commits.subject: Fix an incorrect debug assert (#774)
commits.disposition: Restore cursor directly after automatic final-newline insertion before visual statistics finalize; retain detailed buffer invariants.

commits.subject: Use natural sort for filenames (#763)
commits.disposition: Enable numeric and normalized Unicode ICU collation in file lists and bounded filename completions, retaining directory-first groups and thread-local native service ownership. Cached and scanned completions share natural ordering with an original-name tie break.

commits.subject: Introduce the LSH compiler (#753)
commits.disposition: Latest LSH compiler is already vendored. Fetched-tree comparison confirms compiler implementation; latest highlighting fixtures are added for integration validation.

commits.subject: Add the LSH runtime (#776)
commits.disposition: Latest LSH runtime and compiler CLI already exist in the vendored standalone crate. Retain the heap_bytes accounting extension used to bound cache ownership.

commits.subject: Integrate LSH into edit (#777)
commits.disposition: Keep existing bounded LSH highlighting and add missing status-bar language picker, automatic detection, per-document overrides and Plain Text mode; current runtime already existed.

commits.subject: Add rudimentary settings.json support (#779)
commits.disposition: Add settings.json preferences, ordered files.associations, validation and reload-on-save; apply explicit language selection to syntax caches. Keep automatic state.json separate.

commits.subject: Complete the initial LSH implementation (#624)
commits.disposition: Retain current compiler/grammars, add missing Markdown bold/italic/link/strikethrough paint spans and independent terminal SGR attributes. Preserve OGEdit palette choices.

commits.disposition: PowerShell matching corrections already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.subject: Add a small fuzzing harness for LSH (#782)

commits.subject: lsh: fix strings in PowerShell (#790)

commits.subject: Stop moving focus into the search box (#821)

commits.subject: Fix zero-width regex replace (#815)
commits.disposition: Advance zero-width regex replacement and group Replace All atomically. Also repair empty-replacement progress, stale-pattern replacement and failed-regex grouping edge cases.

commits.subject: Fix text search on *nix (#824)
commits.disposition: The actual fix keeps automatic final newline disabled in generic TextBuffer instances and enables it only for document buffers. OGEdit already separates these using configured document defaults (POSIX by default).

commits.disposition: Fork gutter selection already supports whole-line dragging, Shift extension, wrapping and stable logical anchors; preserve its tested implementation.

commits.disposition: Use host-independent packed RGBA conversion and parsing; preserve existing from_be/from_le callers through compatibility APIs.

commits.subject: Scroll sideways while holding the shift key and scroll fast while holding the alt key (#766)
commits.disposition: Shift routes wheel ticks horizontally; TUI applies normal axis scale and Alt acceleration rather than multiplying twice in the decoder.

commits.disposition: Keep horizontal drags in the top/bottom viewport row from causing vertical autoscroll; include the original press and bound the speed lookup.

commits.disposition: Pin all existing GitHub Actions references to full SHAs while retaining current major versions; add grouped Dependabot maintenance. Do not add Microsoft WinGet publishing.

commits.subject: Allow memset fallback to non SIMD implementation on x86 (#940)
commits.disposition: Select scalar fill when x86 lacks SSE2, and use immutable OnceLock dispatch to avoid races in concurrent editor workers.

commits.subject: json: Double perf, Thirdle memory use (#941)
commits.disposition: Custom JSON/BVec parser architecture is not used in OGEdit. Existing serde_json/jsonc-parser handle the supported features; no claim is made to match the upstream parser performance figures.

commits.subject: Fix a "chunk size must be non-zero" panic (#919)
commits.disposition: Deliver native window-size events separately from input text, use a valid startup viewport, preserve it on zero-size reports and prevent zero-sized bitmap chunks or forged CSI resize events.

commits.subject: Add an Inno Setup Installer (#915)
commits.disposition: Keep OGEdit MSI/package delivery. The upstream Inno/WinGet/Azure installer has Microsoft identity and recursively removes its application directory, so it is not copied over the fork installer.

commits.subject: Don't indent a line the selection stops at column 0 of (#918)
commits.disposition: Exclude a final line-start endpoint from multiline indentation, matching existing multicursor behavior.

commits.subject: Unindent leading whitespace on backspace (#792)
commits.disposition: Within leading whitespace, Backspace unindents to the previous tab stop and Ctrl+Backspace goes to line start. Apply the same operation to multicursors and macro replay; elsewhere and in single-line fields, ordinary deletion remains.

commits.subject: Theoretical fix for crashing when tabbing (#955)
commits.disposition: Restrict Tab traversal to a real ancestor of the focused node so unrelated focus wells cannot borrow the wrong subtree.

commits.subject: Configure CodeQL (#956)
commits.disposition: Add CodeQL Rust workflow/configuration for the fork, with SHA-pinned actions and repository-appropriate permissions.

commits.subject: Fix reading overly large files (#954)
commits.disposition: Checked large-file virtual reservation, robust metadata/stream reads and explicit capacity errors prevent successful truncated loads. Backing replacement frees the old mapping only once.

commits.subject: Turn lsh into a standalone crate (#958)
commits.disposition: LSH was already vendored as the current standalone crate, including compiler, runtime and CLI. Workspace membership now adds its integration checks; no intermediate stdext dependency is restored.

commits.subject: Enable CodeQL for actions (#959)
commits.disposition: Include GitHub Actions in the CodeQL language matrix alongside Rust.

commits.subject: Reintegrate stdext into edit (#960)
commits.disposition: OGEdit already has allocator/helpers within its own crate. Apply runtime fixes independently and adapt the fuzz harness; do not recreate then undo the stdext split.

commits.disposition: Additional C++, F#, JSON and XML filename extensions already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.disposition: Zig grammar already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.disposition: SQL grammar and Zig adjustments already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.subject: Introduce utf8_decode_last (#969)
commits.disposition: Add backward UTF-8 scalar decoding with malformed/truncated-tail tests.

commits.subject: Improve YAML highlighting (#967)
commits.disposition: YAML grammar improvements already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.subject: Don't require grapheme boundaries (#970)
commits.disposition: Allow document chunks to split grapheme clusters at codepoint boundaries, and handle CRLF across the gap in both navigation directions.

commits.subject: Fix undo grouping in TextBuffer benchmarks (#971)
commits.disposition: Trace benchmarks record real Move/Insert/Delete/Replace operations without unconditional cursor moves. Replace All groups explicitly; keep OGEdit separate paste undo semantics.

commits.subject: Improve Arena allocator perf (#974)
commits.disposition: Skip a zero-byte copy intrinsic while growing arena storage, preserving checked alignment and capacity calculations.

commits.subject: Make newline normalization undoable (#978)
commits.disposition: Retain existing reversible eager newline conversion; add preference-only undo and buffered, fully drained encoding writes. Do not adopt output-only normalization that would diverge from editable views/recovery bytes.

commits.subject: Fix several major undo/redo issues (#979)
commits.disposition: Fresh branch/reload revisions, save barriers, adjacency-aware history, exact-byte replay and grapheme-seam remeasurement. Retain complete bounded history groups, current-layout undo and nested/multicursor transactions.

commits.subject: Introduce copious amounts of TextBuffer tests (#980)
commits.disposition: Adapt 25 upstream buffer regressions and add fork-specific edge cases. Add anonymous temporary-file helpers. Two output-only normalization cases are represented by equivalent eager-conversion tests.

commits.subject: Fix multiline strings for .js/.py/.sh (#973)
commits.disposition: JavaScript/Python/Shell multiline matching and associated runtime/compiler fixes already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

commits.subject: unix: Fix EINTR handling in write_stdout (#982)
commits.disposition: Unix output advances the actual remaining slice, retries EINTR, handles zero writes and waits for writability after EAGAIN without looping on hangups.

commits.subject: unix: Avoid open() in file_id() (#983)
commits.disposition: Unix file identity uses metadata device/inode instead of opening a file merely to identify it.

commits.subject: unix: Fix lang selection with an empty LANGUAGE env var (#984)
commits.disposition: Empty/delimiter-only LANGUAGE falls back correctly; include LC_MESSAGES between LC_ALL and LANG.

commits.subject: unix: Fix EINTR handling around termios (#985)
commits.disposition: Retry interrupted terminal setup/restore, apply current raw-mode flags and preserve original descriptor flags; close the reopened terminal descriptor during cleanup.

commits.subject: Fix lsh manifest (#988)
commits.disposition: Vendored LSH already uses valid parsing/text-processing/compilers categories and syntax/highlighter/highlighting keywords. Local standalone manifest metadata is intentional.

commits.subject: python.lsh: Avoid capturing underscores as numeric literals (#981)
commits.disposition: Numeric-literal underscore handling in Python and the other updated language grammars already present in the vendored latest LSH snapshot; confirmed against fetched upstream. Newly copied fixtures extend validation, not the claimed provenance of runtime changes.

integration_method: Adapted backports in the existing working tree; no Git ancestry merge or commit was created.

status_definitions.backported: Applicable changes were implemented or adapted during this integration. A mixed commit may retain documented fork-specific structures.
status_definitions.already_present: Relevant behavior/source was already present before this integration and was verified; added validation assets do not imply newly ported runtime code.
status_definitions.superseded: An intermediate organization, redundant implementation or weaker alternative is replaced by an explicitly documented existing fork design.
status_definitions.not_applicable: The change targets Microsoft-specific distribution/release identity or a collection implementation not used by OGEdit.

asan.initial_parallel_worker_timeout: Passed isolated recheck and complete serial suite; assertions unchanged.

browser.release_acceptance: pass: 12 documents, 8 panels, 20 palettes, 16 byte-verified Save As operations
browser.release_churn: pass: five rounds, 30 documents, 20 panels, 100 palettes

memory.span_definition: Last minus first sample timestamp, including gaps.
memory.vms_note: platform_vms is platform-specific; Windows vms is commit/pagefile usage, not reserved virtual address space. Legacy reserved_virtual_bytes is not summarized.
